terms.comment: Our extension: classically a book of wooden tablets, and so a book, an account book (Cic., in Lewis & Short s.v. caudex). Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for a program’s code; Morgan–Owens’s cifrae (s.v. code) are secret writing.

sources: Lewis & Short: codex
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. code, coded writing.
